packages.title: STEP and STL mechanical CAD
packages.scope: 54 individual STEP solids and STLs, one 54-solid home assembly in both formats, three concept drawing sheets/PDF. Millimetres. No six-pose bulk duplication.

packages.title: Native FreeCAD solid assembly
packages.scope: 54-solid native FreeCAD home assembly with semantic metadata. Solid export, not parametric feature history.

packages.title: Editable KiCad project and references
packages.scope: Native KiCad10 project/schematic/board/rules, portable library tables, local F1 footprint, BOM, assumptions, schematic/layer PDFs, native preview and self-contained GLB. No machine cache, global libraries or fabrication order.

packages.title: Native PCB STEP for mechanical inspection
packages.scope: Native KiCad-generated board and fitted-component STEP geometry; electrical editing remains in the KiCad project.

license: Existing project MIT LICENSE and NOTICE.md preserved verbatim; KiCad design/generated-file library exception retained.
privacy_scan: All packaged bytes scanned for local machine/user paths and explicit private-key/GitHub/API token patterns. This is a bounded content check, not an exhaustive security certification.
not_executed: No native GUI or physical tests; original geometry/PCB and source-bound evidence were preserved. Archive/parser/header/copy checks ran on the packaged files.
